ValidationRule.description: Customer class is not required for: PAYER Entry - 0003 - Salem/MI Sold to - 0001 - Salem/MIA Ship To - 0002 - Montreal
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $User.Alias<> "sconn",
OR( AND( $RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Salem/MIA", ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "PAYER Entry - 0003"), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Customer_Class__c))) ),
AND( $RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Montreal", ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Ship To - 0002"), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Customer_Class__c))) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Customer Class is not applicable for selected Account Group.
